statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53612 (GHSA-g8wm-75wr-g2vh): in util-linux 2.39 through 2.41.4 and 2.42 through 2.42.1, the X-mount.owner, X-mount.group and X-mount.mode post-mount hook of the setuid mount(8) (libmount/src/hook_owner.c) changes ownership and mode by path after the mount, so a local user allowed to mount a user or users fstab entry with those options can swap an ancestor directory and redirect the privileged change to a root-owned path. Upstream fixed it in 2.41.5 by switching to fd-based fchownat and chmod: https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/897a08c2b11dfa66975c3d24d63c7bf5f5be1a7c, which names this CVE (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-g8wm-75wr-g2vh). Alpine lists it fixed in util-linux 2.41.6-r0 for 3.23 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-53612). The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes util-linux 2.41.2-r0, 2.41.4-r0, 2.41.6-r0 and 2.41.6-r1 on x86_64 and aarch64. 2.41.2-r0 and 2.41.4-r0 are built from releases older than the fix. 2.41.6-r0 and 2.41.6-r1 are built from upstream 2.41.6, which contains that commit; the libmount library in the x86_64 2.41.6-r0 package reports version 2.41.6.

CVE-2026-53612 (GHSA-g8wm-75wr-g2vh): in util-linux 2.39 through 2.41.4 and 2.42 through 2.42.1, the X-mount.owner, X-mount.group and X-mount.mode post-mount hook of the setuid mount(8) (libmount/src/hook_owner.c) changes ownership and mode by path after the mount, so a local user allowed to mount a user or users fstab entry with those options can swap an ancestor directory and redirect the privileged change to a root-owned path. Upstream fixed it in 2.41.5: https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/commit/897a08c2b11dfa66975c3d24d63c7bf5f5be1a7c, which names this CVE. Debian fixed it in trixie with 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6442-1, Debian bug 1140194, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-53612). The DHI Debian repository publishes rebuilds of Debian 2.41.5-0+deb13u1, the lowest of which is the fixed version here, and older rebuilds of Debian 2.41-5, which predate the fix and sort below it. The Debian changelog shipped in the 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 rebuilds records the new upstream version 2.41.5 fixing this CVE, and the libmount library in the current amd64 rebuild reports version 2.41.5.
